notes: Inbox 2026-09-15: posix ci red on 2 of 12 main runs, always ENOTEMPTY rmdir .git/objects at fixture teardown, never an assertion. gc.autoDetach is on by default, so the gc git starts outlives the test and races the recursive remove. Liveness is deliberately not a leg here; the fork is the open question, and this entry ships under every branch of it.
